spans.s:
A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with त्रिच् or अक , when the force of the genitive case is that of an agent.

Terms: समास-विभक्ति-6

The word क्रोष्टु 'a jackal' is treated in the strong cases (with the exception of Vocative Case singular) as if it ended in तृच् (तृ).

Terms: Some substitution
